|lore=Captives sent to the Kessel spice mines spend the rest of their lives digging for glitterstim, a spice sold throughout the galaxy by smugglers and crime lords.
|game_text=Deploy on Kessel. While your Star Destroyer here, opponent may not play Interrupts from their Lost Pile. If opponent just forfeited a character here, may place this Effect in Lost Pile to retrieve Force equal to that character’s forfeit. (Immune to Alter.)

|notes=The Players Committee remaster for Spice Mines Of Kessel gives official wording dated 4 December 2006. See [[Spice Mines of Kessel (V) (Virtual Set 3)|Original]] for the earlier presentation. The earlier and later articles preserve both issuer spellings.
